elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: The Company owns all right, title and interest in the Site, Content, and all other deliverables and work product created for it.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly assigns the Site, Content, deliverables, and work product to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause states that HDI retains all right, title and interest in its pre-existing intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The embedded HDI intellectual-property licence is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded HDI intellectual-property licence is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded HDI intellectual-property licence is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company retains all right, title and interest in all user, customer, and transaction data collected through the Site.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides that no intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the parties.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI retains only its pre-existing intellectual property; the clause does not generally reserve ownership of generic tools or know-how, including those developed under the agreement.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables outright, a stronger perpetual interest, and its licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables outright, and its licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Neither the ownership assignment nor the embedded-IP licence expressly states that the granted rights are worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables without a royalty obligation, and the licence covering embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Although the Company owns the Deliverables, the licence to embedded HDI intellectual property does not expressly include modification rights, which may be necessary to modify complete Deliverables.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded HDI intellectual property contains no sublicensing right, so the Company cannot clearly sublicense complete Deliverables containing that IP.
